turns.question: How many site sessions were there per order placed between 20 September and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: Between 20 September and 2 October 2026 (inclusive) there were 7 site sessions and 75 orders, which is about 0.09 site sessions per order (7 divided by 75, computed from the two query_metrics figures).
